title: A record that answers to a key through two of its rows is one target, not two
intent: Two rows of contacts.csv carry the same contact id C-1 with the same values, so they are one contact, and the second row is absorbed. A company names that contact by C-1. The contact answers to C-1 through both of its rows, and a relationship to it must resolve to the one record it is; counting the record once per row would call its own id ambiguous.
